note: Cameras for R152's before / after hub previews (render_base_area.mjs of R151). pos / look are world studs (the track runs to +Z; hub floor top y = 4); fov is the vertical field of view. avatars: [x, y, z, yaw, shirt colour].

views.name: aerial
views.title: The hub from above
views.caption: The whole base area. AFTER: a chess-rook battlement round every wall, a rook tower on each side of the track gate, no corner towers, no fountain, a third of the trees, no signposts, banners, murals or base arches.

views.name: gate
views.title: The track gate (rook towers)
views.caption: From the hub: two chess-rook towers (stepped round base, tapering shaft, gold ring, collar, flared crown with eight merlons) and a crenellated gatehouse between them with the sign on its raised keep and the seven biome keys hanging in front. No red crest, no flags.

views.name: rook
views.title: A rook tower up close
views.caption: The east tower from the hub side: a wide round stepped base, a shaft that tapers a little with two arrow slits, a gold ring where the wall's string course runs, a stone collar, a flared crown and eight square merlons; the wall's battlement runs up to it on the left, the gatehouse's on the right.

views.name: corner
views.title: A wall corner
views.caption: The front-east corner: the battlement runs round it, one square merlon on the corner, nothing higher (no tower, no cone roof). The pilasters end under it with stone caps.

views.name: run
views.title: A straight run of wall
views.caption: The east wall: square merlons every ten studs, the same size and rhythm all the way round, pilasters and lanterns under them.

views.name: plaza
views.title: The old fountain spot
views.caption: The south plaza where the Seed Fountain stood: a clean open paved circle, no benches, no spouts, nothing to look at but the lawn and the stage behind.

views.name: entrance
views.title: At a base entrance
views.caption: Base 3 from the west street: the street, curbs, spur and welcome mat stay; the arch, posts, name beam, medallion, pennants and potted topiary are gone.

views.name: spawn
views.title: Leaving a base
views.caption: What a player sees leaving Base 1: the open paved street, a few trees at the edges, the avenue, and the rook towers of the gate to the right.
